description: This file defines the `ExecCommandResolution` struct and associated static methods for resolving executable commands, parsing shell command chains, tokenizing command strings, and handling different invocation scenarios within a software project. It appears to manage command resolution logic for executing valid commands and allows for complex shell command parsing.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct representing the resolution of a command, including its raw input, resolved path, executable name, and current working directory. Contains multiple static methods for resolving commands and parsing shell command chains.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a command based on the provided command array, raw command string, current working directory, and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves commands for allowlist purposes, handling shell wrappers and command segments, filtering based on system command validation.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Collects command patterns that are always allowed, used for security or policy enforcement.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable's path from a raw executable string considering tilde expansion and search paths.

methods.name: resolveShellSegmentExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable for a shell segment, tokenizing the shell command.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects patterns that are always allowed based on command analysis.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Detects and unwraps shell multiplexers like busybox or toybox to parse wrapped commands.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a command string, respecting quotes.

methods.name: tokenizeShellWords
methods.description: Splits a shell command string into tokens, handling quotes and escape sequences.

methods.name: splitShellCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a composite shell command into individual segments based on command delimiters, respecting quoting and escape sequences.
